name: breadcrumbs
description: UIDS breadcrumbs component contract, preserving the verified 4.x rendering and documenting the proposed Figma representation.

figma.note: BUILT (Phase 3) as a single COMPONENT (node 202:8, key f377d183c4b104a7ee57d89eb0d0a17b55052c3c), not a COMPONENT_SET. No formal axes; Default and On Black are documentation/context frames around the same component.
axisRationale: Breadcrumbs has no styling prop or persistent visual state worth a variant axis. Link distribution and crumb count are content, not axes; disabled is unreachable.

componentSetName / componentSetId / componentKey are deliberately omitted from the structured fields: check-figma.mjs guards against an orphaned id/key with no name, because that would silently skip set validation — and there is no set here to validate.
Ancestor backgrounds shown as context frames follows the established Headline/Button treatment.
figma.precedent: Headline / Button (ancestor backgrounds as context frames).

options.name: items
options.description: Keys per item: text, url. The LAST item is the current page and is rendered without a link (the trail's leaf), so callers pass the full trail including the current page rather than stopping short of it. Required, with no default: the component renders nothing without it. Added 2026-08-20 to close the long-standing check-contracts warning that this Vue prop was unclaimed by any contract option — the schema already supported array/object option types.

code.notes: Vue marks it required:true with type:Array and no default.

figma.notes: Content, not a variant axis: the number of entries drives how many rows/tabs/crumbs are drawn, which Figma expresses by duplicating the child instance rather than by a variant property.

options.name: heading_id
options.description: ID used by the visually-hidden Breadcrumb heading and the nav's aria-labelledby attribute.

slots.name: items
slots.description: A required Array prop rather than a Vue slot. Each item is {text, url?}; linked items render anchors and unlinked items render text.
slots.behavior: The array order defines the trail. CSS generates a slash after every item except the last. There is no runtime validator for item shape and no explicit current-item field.

figma.notes: Model as repeated text/link layers with a recommended three-crumb example; count and labels remain editable content.

behavior: Breadcrumbs.vue mirrors Drupal Classy's breadcrumb.html.twig markup: nav.breadcrumb > visually-hidden h2 + ol > li, with anchors only when an item has a URL.
Slash separators are generated by li:not(:last-child)::after; they are not part of accessible text or the items data.
Under an ancestor whose class contains bg--black, both linked and unlinked crumb text flip to white while the separator remains primary-channel gold.

In production, .hero__content reduces top margin from 1.75rem to 1rem. uids_base's separate hero.scss also makes breadcrumb text white at sm and its onecol background layout adds container-query context overrides; those are downstream layout ownership, not Breadcrumb-owned tier-3 values.
knownIssues: The initial $sm root margin-top/margin-bottom declarations are specificity-dead because an equal-specificity .breadcrumb block later sets 1.75rem/0; only their zero inline margins survive.
.breadcrumb .disabled has no producer in Breadcrumbs.vue, Drupal Classy's breadcrumb template, or the searched production preprocess/config paths. It is tokenized as shipped but excluded from Figma.
The default heading_id is shared by every instance, so rendering multiple Breadcrumbs components without overriding it creates duplicate IDs.
The current item is represented only by absence of a URL. Neither the Vue component nor the Classy Twig template adds aria-current=page.
The .block-system-breadcrumb-block .hero__content nested block contains only a malformed commented @include and emits no CSS.

geometryNotTokenized.placement-margins: Root margin-top:1.75rem and hero-context margin-top:1rem are outer placement values; margin-bottom is reset to 0. They stay raw, matching Pager/Button precedent that component placement margins are not identity tokens.
geometryNotTokenized.clearfix: ::before/::after display:table/content/clear implements a float clearfix. flex/order declarations on those pseudo-elements are inert in every known current context because .breadcrumb is not a flex container.
geometryNotTokenized.float-layout: Each li floats left and the ol extends %no-ul-list. This legacy layout mechanism and list reset are structural rather than tokenizable values.
geometryNotTokenized.interaction: Links remove text-decoration at rest and underline on hover/focus; text-decoration keywords are not design-token values.
geometryNotTokenized.block-z-index: .block-system-breadcrumb-block uses z-index:1 as downstream stacking geometry and is not represented in the standalone Vue component.
